name: zenix-music-player
description: Zenix 桌面音乐播放器，玻璃贴纸音乐空间与桌面歌词
author: 17hwliao

scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.android:build: node scripts/Prepare-Android.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode android && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Build-Android.ps1
scripts.ios:web: node scripts/Prepare-iOS.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run ios:web && cross-env ZENIX_PLATFORM=ios cap sync ios
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/Test-Regression.cjs scripts/Test-Mobile.cjs scripts/Test-Security.cjs scripts/Test-PlayerBar.cjs scripts/Test-Windows-Protection.cjs scripts/Test-PlayerUi.cjs scripts/Test-UpdateReminders.cjs scripts/Test-Companion.cjs scripts/Test-MobilePlayback.cjs scripts/Test-AndroidUpdates.cjs scripts/Test-StoreProtection.cjs scripts/Test-UpdatePipeline.cjs scripts/Test-ReleasePolicy.cjs scripts/Test-SourceShare.cjs
scripts.android:release: npm run android:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Build-Android.ps1 -Release
